title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1966-09-16

ai_review.summary: Highly praised vintage recording with nostalgic vibes and a classic set of early Dead songs, though technical details are scarce
ai_review.review: Both reviewers speak fondly of the tape, highlighting its nostalgic value and noting that it contains many of the early‑era tracks that appear on historic compilations. No specific comments about sound quality or performance nuances were provided, but the high star ratings suggest a generally positive listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Average of reviewer stars is 4.5; lack of technical detail lowers confidence and modestly reduces the rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not mention soundboard, audience mix, clarity, or any audio issues; assessment based on overall positive star ratings.
